cardOverview.overviewText: A super-premium card designed for affluent customers, providing elite travel privileges, unlimited lounge access, concierge services, and rewards across luxury categories.

benefitRows.name: Birthday
benefitRows.offer: Earn 2,500 Bonus Reward Points on completing one retail transaction on your birthday.

benefitRows.name: Concierge
benefitRows.offer: AU Bank Zenith Credit card provides 24×7 global concierge services for bookings and reservations at 1800 210 0298 (toll-free) or 022-42320298.
benefitRows.howToAvail: You may dial 1800 210 0298 (toll-free) or 022-42320298 for concierge assistance.
